title: Freelancer Skill Definition
description: How a freelancer works, what they need, and the questions they ask. Drives the adaptive intake and the structure of the client brief.

skill.description: Short name of this skill, kebab-case. Example: 'workflow-automation-review'.

version.description: Semantic version of this skill definition.

provider.description: Who created this skill (name or org).

description.description: One sentence: what this skill does.

how_i_work.description: List of statements about how you work and your approach.
examples: I review one workflow end-to-end and return concrete, prioritised fixes.
I work in focused 2-hour blocks; billing is for productive time only.

what_i_need.description: What inputs or materials are required to do the work.
examples: read-only access to the relevant system

questions_i_ask.description: Questions the intake agent should ask to understand the client's need.
examples: What is the single outcome you want improved?
Where does it currently break or slow down?

exclusions.description: What you will NOT work with. Security and scope boundaries.
examples: No production credentials. Read-only, scoped access only.
Do not send PII unless strictly required for the task.

deliverables.description: What the client receives at the end.
examples: one quick-win fix applied and tested

quality_criteria.description: How quality is defined and verified.
examples: every claim references a source artifact
every change includes a brief explanation

vault_scope.description: How widely the vault contents can be used.

data_retention.description: How long vault contents are retained. Examples: '14d_then_revoke', 'manual_deletion_only'.

approval_required_before_external_action.description: True = nothing external happens without human approval.

no_production_credentials.description: True = reject any production passwords, API keys, etc.

no_pii_unless_required.description: True = only collect PII if absolutely necessary for the work.

completion_conditions.description: How you know the work is done.
examples: human approval received on return handover

notes.description: Caveats or scoping context a client should read before engaging.
